question.knowledge_point: Calculating a Probability Involving a Transformed Random Variable
question.problem:
The random variable $X$ has the following probability distribution.

| $x$ | $-4$ | $-2$ | $0$ | $2$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${f}_{X}(x)$ | $\frac{1}{6}$ | $\frac{1}{12}$ | $\frac{5}{12}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{1}{12}$ |

Let $Y=\frac{X}{2}+2.$ Calculate $P(1\le Y\le 3).$
